MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper fits my current fastening work because I could use it to check screw diameters and match hardware sizes.",
    "Practical hardware tools connect with my recent nails, screws, and anchors when they help me use or measure those fasteners."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The temperature guns do not help with my current fastening and mounting tasks; I have no surface-temperature measurement need.",
    "Glue, epoxy, and leak-repair putty address repairs I have not shown a need for, while my recent choices involve screws, nails, and anchors.",
    "The nuts and half-inch washers require matching bolts that my recent purchases do not establish, and the cutting wheels require a metal-cutting task and compatible tool.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape would exceed my current needs, even if tape could occasionally be useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Being broadly useful for workshop or household repairs seems to count too much compared with helping with the specific work I am doing.",
    "Hardware seems to be treated as interchangeable, although wood screws, framing nails, bolt nuts, and large washers serve different connections."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors suggest that fastening method and mounting surface matter to my current choices.",
    "Exact dimensions and compatibility matter: a related-looking part is only useful if it fits the fasteners or tools involved.",
    "I choose supplies for a concrete current need, so unrelated repair uses and quantities far beyond that need are weak matches."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical project supplies but mostly missed the specific fastening tasks and compatibility that make an item useful to me now."
}
